subject: BlueSail hosted API eval — scheduling & pre-demo prep
messages:
From: Harper Lane <harper@bluesail.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request — BlueSail Labs

Thanks for the quick signup confirmation — excited to get a look at Redwood's Hosted API. A few details to help with scheduling:
- We're evaluating for product recommendations and A/B testing (high QPS expected at peak).
- Prefer a 45-minute technical walkthrough + sandbox access so our lead ML engineer (Jordan) can verify model quality and latency.
- Timezone: PST (San Francisco). Best windows for us this week are afternoons after 2:00pm PT.

If possible we'd like sandbox credentials and any pre-demo checklist earlier in the day so Jordan can preload a small dataset. Happy to take a recording if we need to shift.

Thanks,
Harper Lane
Head of ML Ops, BlueSail Labs
harper@bluesail.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Harper Lane <harper@bluesail.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request — BlueSail Labs

Hi Harper — great to meet you (virtually)! Thanks for the context. I can host a 45-min sandbox walkthrough this week. Options (all PT):
- Wed 16 Jun, 2:30pm–3:15pm
- Thu 17 Jun, 3:00pm–3:45pm
- Fri 18 Jun, 1:00pm–1:45pm (if earlier works)

Please pick whichever works best and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve attached a short pre-demo checklist and sandbox-access steps — Jordan can use the sandbox creds to push a small test payload ahead of time. Quick note: if you need a deeper perf/latency session Diego can join for the second half — looping him in.

Attachments (stubs): pre-demo-checklist.pdf (1 page), sandbox-access-steps.txt
Links: https://drive.redwood.com/s/abc123/preflight — sample datasets and instructions

Thanks,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Harper Lane <harper@bluesail.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Pierce <jordan@bluesail.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request — BlueSail Labs

Thanks Ben — appreciate the up-front materials. Unfortunately something popped up on our end and we need to move the Wed 2:30pm slot. Thu 3:00pm PT looks promising but can you do Thu 4:15pm PT instead? Jordan has a calendar conflict until 3:30pm and would prefer 4:15 if available.

If 4:15 doesn't work we can do Thu 3:00pm and Jordan will catch the recording. Also — could you include an ICS calendar file? That helps with our procurement team's approvals.

Harper

Hi Harper — thanks for the heads up and for looping Jordan in. Thu 16 Jun at 4:15pm PT works for us; I’ve attached a calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and bumped the session to 50 minutes to allow Diego to do a quick perf deep-dive after the walkthrough.

Pre-demo items (please complete if possible before the call):
- Upload a 500–1k row CSV (sample format in the Drive link) to the sandbox link we shared.
- Note a couple of representative prompts or call patterns you expect in production.
- If you want, paste a single error or failure mode you saw in your prior infra so we can prioritize troubleshooting.

Ben will send the sandbox creds to Jordan in a separate note; Diego and I will prepare a short latency/throughput summary tailored to your expected QPS. If anything changes, reply-all and we’ll adapt. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
On behalf of Redwood Inference
